stories.title: Create and edit a Draft leave request
stories.narrative: As an Employee, I want to create a leave or exception request and edit it while it is a Draft, so that I can prepare an accurate request before submitting it.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am signed in as Employee on My requests
acceptanceCriteria.when: I choose New request, enter type Vacation, start 2031-04-14, end 2031-04-15, 8 hours and save the draft
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request detail shows status "Draft" and the hours I entered

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am editing a Draft
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter a reason of 501 characters and save
acceptanceCriteria.then: saving is refused with "Reason must be 500 characters or fewer; remove 1 characters." and the status stays "Draft"

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am editing a Draft
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter an end date earlier than the start date and save
acceptanceCriteria.then: saving is refused with "End date must be on or after the start date."

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on My requests
acceptanceCriteria.when: I activate New request, then Save draft, then change the hours to 12 and save again
acceptanceCriteria.then: the form opens on New request, the detail appears after the first save and shows 12 h after the second save

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am editing a Draft
acceptanceCriteria.when: I enter a reason of exactly 500 characters and save
acceptanceCriteria.then: the draft is saved with status "Draft" and no reason-length message is shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am signed in as Manager
acceptanceCriteria.then: no New request control is present and no request form is shown

stories.statusReason: All 6/6 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Live balance and rule indicators while typing
stories.narrative: As an Employee, I want to see my available balance, the post-request balance, the certification need and the earliest allowed start date update as I type, so that I fix problems before submitting.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am Sam Chen (available balance 40 h) and the request form is open
acceptanceCriteria.then: the available balance reads "40 h" and the post-request balance reads "32 h" immediately

acceptanceCriteria.given: the form is open for Sam Chen (40 h available)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the post-request balance reads "0 h" and no balance warning is shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: the form is open for Sam Chen (40 h available)
acceptanceCriteria.then: an inline message says the requested hours exceed the available balance by 0.5 h, before any submit

acceptanceCriteria.given: the form is open for Sam Chen (40 h available)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the post-request balance reads "0.5 h"

acceptanceCriteria.given: the form is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: I set type Vacation with 41 hours, then 40 hours, then type Exception with 8 hours
acceptanceCriteria.then: the certification indicator reads "HR certification required" for 41 h, "Manager approval is final" for 40 h, and "HR certification required" for Exception

acceptanceCriteria.given: the form is open and today is 2031-03-02
acceptanceCriteria.when: I choose type Vacation, then type Exception
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lead-time hint reads "Earliest start date: 2031-03-05" for Vacation and "No lead time required for Exception" for Exception

stories.statusReason: All 6/6 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Submit a request with balance, lead-time and overlap validation
stories.narrative: As an Employee, I want to submit my Draft and be told exactly what to fix when a rule blocks it, so that my request reaches my manager without back-and-forth.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have a valid Draft (Vacation, 2031-04-21 to 2031-04-22, 8 h)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status reads "Submitted" and the next approver reads "Manager"

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am Sam Chen with 40 h available and a Draft of 48 h
acceptanceCriteria.then: submission is blocked with "Requested hours exceed your available balance by 8 h. Reduce the request to at most 40 h." and the status stays "Draft"

acceptanceCriteria.given: today is 2031-03-02 and my Draft is Vacation starting 2031-03-04
acceptanceCriteria.then: submission is blocked with a message containing "at least 3 calendar days before the start date" and "2031-03-05", and the status stays "Draft"

acceptanceCriteria.given: my request LR-1001 already covers 2031-06-09 to 2031-06-13
acceptanceCriteria.when: I submit a Draft for 2031-06-12 to 2031-06-16
acceptanceCriteria.then: submission is blocked with a message containing "overlap your existing request LR-1001" and the status stays "Draft"

acceptanceCriteria.given: today is 2031-03-02
acceptanceCriteria.when: I submit a Vacation Draft starting exactly 2031-03-05 (3 calendar days ahead)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is accepted and reads "Submitted"

acceptanceCriteria.given: today is 2031-03-02
acceptanceCriteria.when: I submit an Exception Draft starting 2031-03-04 (2 days ahead)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is accepted and reads "Submitted" because Exceptions are exempt from the lead time

acceptanceCriteria.given: a submit was blocked by the balance rule
acceptanceCriteria.then: the validation summary has role alert, the hours field is marked aria-invalid="true" and is described by the message

acceptanceCriteria.given: my request has just been submitted
acceptanceCriteria.when: I look at the available actions
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Submit control is shown for a Submitted request and the status remains "Submitted"

stories.statusReason: All 8/8 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Withdraw a request before it is approved
stories.narrative: As an Employee, I want to withdraw my own request while it is still Draft, Submitted or Manager approved, so that I can cancel plans without involving HR.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have a Draft
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status reads "Withdrawn"

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have a Submitted request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status reads "Withdrawn" and the next approver reads "—"

acceptanceCriteria.given: my request LR-1002 is Approved (awaiting payroll)
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Withdraw control is present and the status stays "Approved"

acceptanceCriteria.given: my request LR-1001 is Posted to payroll
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Withdraw control is present and the status stays "Posted to payroll"

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am the Manager viewing an employee's Submitted request
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Withdraw control is present

acceptanceCriteria.given: I have just withdrawn a request
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Submit or Withdraw control remains and the status region announces "Withdrawn"

stories.statusReason: All 6/6 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Request history with readable statuses and next approver
stories.narrative: As an Employee, I want a history of my requests with plain-language statuses, the next approver and any return comment, so that I always know where a request stands.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am Alex Rivera
acceptanceCriteria.then: the history lists LR-1001 as "Posted to payroll", LR-1002 as "Approved" with next approver "Payroll" and LR-1006 as "Submitted" with next approver "Manager"

acceptanceCriteria.given: my manager returned my request with the comment "Please shorten to two days"
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request reads "Draft" and the return comment "Please shorten to two days" is shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am Alex Rivera
acceptanceCriteria.then: requests of other employees (such as LR-1003) are not listed

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on My requests
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open LR-1001 from the history
acceptanceCriteria.then: the detail shows LR-1001 with status "Posted to payroll"

acceptanceCriteria.given: I browse My requests, the detail and the form
acceptanceCriteria.then: no raw status code such as MANAGER_APPROVED or POSTED appears anywhere; only labels are shown

stories.statusReason: All 5/5 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Manager queue with approve and return
stories.narrative: As a Manager, I want a queue of Submitted requests from my direct reports with Approve and Return actions, so that I can decide quickly and route large requests to HR.

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1006 (8 h Vacation from my direct report Alex Rivera) is Submitted
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open it from the Manager queue and approve it
acceptanceCriteria.then: manager approval is final: the history shows "Submitted → Approved" and, after the automatic payroll posting, the status reads "Posted to payroll"

acceptanceCriteria.given: my direct report submitted a 48 h Vacation request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status reads "Manager approved" and the next approver reads "HR Certifier"

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Submitted request from my direct report is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: I choose Return without a comment
acceptanceCriteria.then: the return is refused with "A comment is required to return a request. Tell the employee what to change." and the status stays "Submitted"

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Submitted request from my direct report is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: I return it with the comment "Please shorten to two days"
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status reads "Draft" and the return comment is shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am the Employee viewing my own Submitted request
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Approve and no Return control is present

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1003 was submitted by Jordan Blake, who reports to another manager
acceptanceCriteria.then: LR-1003 is not listed

acceptanceCriteria.given: an employee's request is still a Draft
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Approve control is present and the status stays "Draft"

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1006 is listed in my queue
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open it and approve it
acceptanceCriteria.then: the detail loads LR-1006 and the queue no longer lists LR-1006

stories.statusReason: All 8/8 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: HR certification queue with certify and return
stories.narrative: As an HR Certifier, I want a queue of Manager-approved requests that need certification (more than 40 h or Exception), so that second-level approval happens in one place.

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1004 (Exception, Manager approved) exists
acceptanceCriteria.then: LR-1004 is listed

acceptanceCriteria.given: a 48 h request was approved by the manager
acceptanceCriteria.then: the history shows "Manager approved → Approved" and the status reads "Posted to payroll" after the automatic payroll posting

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Manager-approved request is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: I choose Return without a comment
acceptanceCriteria.then: the return is refused with "A comment is required to return a request" and the status stays "Manager approved"

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Manager-approved request is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: I return it with the comment "Attach the exception form"
acceptanceCriteria.then: the status reads "Draft" and the comment "Attach the exception form" is shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am the Manager viewing a Manager-approved request
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Certify control is present

acceptanceCriteria.given: a request is only Submitted (not yet manager approved)
acceptanceCriteria.when: I view it as HR Certifier
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Certify control is present and the status stays "Submitted"

stories.statusReason: All 6/6 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Post approved requests to payroll and record the outcome
stories.narrative: As the Payroll Integration, I want every Approved request posted to the payroll REST endpoint with the result recorded, so that HR never re-keys outcomes.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a request has just been approved
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open it in the Payroll postings view
acceptanceCriteria.then: the posting outcome reads "Accepted by payroll" with a payroll reference and the status reads "Posted to payroll"

acceptanceCriteria.given: payroll rejected the posting of LR-1002
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open the Payroll postings view
acceptanceCriteria.then: an alert "Payroll posting failed" is listed for LR-1002 and its status stays "Approved"

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am signed in as Employee
acceptanceCriteria.then: no payroll posting log is shown

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1001 was posted successfully
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open LR-1001 from the posting log
acceptanceCriteria.then: the detail shows status "Posted to payroll" and the posting outcome "Accepted by payroll"

stories.statusReason: All 4/4 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Immutable audit trail of every state change
stories.narrative: As a Manager or HR Certifier, I want every state change recorded with actor, time, previous and new state, so that lost approvals can be traced.

acceptanceCriteria.given: Alex Rivera submitted a request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit log lists "Draft → Submitted" by Alex Rivera with a timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.then: it lists "Submitted → Approved" by Morgan Lee and "Approved → Posted to payroll" by Payroll Integration

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1001 is Posted to payroll
acceptanceCriteria.when: the HR Certifier tries to certify it through the API
acceptanceCriteria.then: the attempt is refused and the audit log records a denied attempt for LR-1001

acceptanceCriteria.given: an audit record exists
acceptanceCriteria.when: a client tries to update or delete it through the API
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 405 and the record is unchanged

stories.statusReason: All 4/4 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Server-side workflow and role guards
stories.narrative: As the system, I want every transition validated against the frozen state table and RBAC matrix in the backend, so that the UI is never the only guard.

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1001 is Posted to payroll
acceptanceCriteria.when: the Employee calls the submit operation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 409 with a message containing "not available for a request that is Posted to payroll" and the status is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1006 is Submitted
acceptanceCriteria.when: the Employee calls the approve operation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 403 with "Only the employee's manager can approve or return this request."

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1003 belongs to an employee who does not report to Morgan Lee
acceptanceCriteria.when: Morgan Lee calls the approve operation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 403 and LR-1003 stays Submitted

acceptanceCriteria.given: LR-1002 is Approved
acceptanceCriteria.when: the Employee calls the withdraw operation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 409 and the status stays Approved

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am the Employee with a Draft open
acceptanceCriteria.when: I look at the available actions
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly the Submit and Withdraw controls are present; Approve, Return and Certify are absent

stories.statusReason: All 5/5 linked tests passed and verified

stories.title: Identity adapter, PII masking and input hardening

acceptanceCriteria.then: the employee identifier is masked as "EMP-•••42" and the full identifier is nowhere on the page

acceptanceCriteria.given: a client sends no identity
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 401 with a readable message

acceptanceCriteria.given: the Employee creates a request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API answers 400 with "Enter the requested hours (more than 0)."

acceptanceCriteria.given: the Manager reads LR-1006 through the API
acceptanceCriteria.then: it carries the masked employee reference and no national identifier field

acceptanceCriteria.given: the Employee creates a request through the API
acceptanceCriteria.when: the reason has 500 characters, then 501 characters
acceptanceCriteria.then: 500 is accepted (201) and 501 is refused (400) with the 500-character message

stories.statusReason: All 5/5 linked tests passed and verified
